```php
<?php

use App\Models\Note;
use Faker\Factory as Faker;

class NoteSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run()
    {
        $faker = Faker::create();

        for ($i = 1; $i <= 50; $i++) {
            Note::factory()->create([
                'title' => $faker->sentence,
                'content' => $faker->paragraph,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```
